name: AWS
description: Your AWS accounts in prifly, read-only: resources, CloudWatch alarms and a daily cost reading, through the access key filed in Vault → Connections. Tools for every session and a launch board with your accounts, cost, alarms and the calls sessions made; an alarm there starts an investigation. Nothing in the status bar. prifly signs every call; the extension never sees a secret.
